pack.title: Property lines hoa
pack.description: Request a factual discussion before changing your property.

scenarios.setting: A neighbor tells you to cut down a tree they dislike.
scenarios.jab: That tree has to go; it's ruining my view.
scenarios.goal: Request a factual discussion before changing your property.

replies.line: Let's check the boundaries and rules before discussing changes.
replies.why: It moves the disagreement toward verifiable information rather than demands.
replies.delivery: Use a neutral tone and avoid claiming legal rights you have not checked.

replies.why: It pauses the decision until the relevant facts are understood.
replies.delivery: Use a neutral tone and avoid claiming legal rights you have not checked.

replies.line: I hear your concern; could you show me the rule you're referring to so we can review it?
replies.why: It invites evidence without agreeing to remove the tree.
replies.delivery: Use a neutral tone and avoid claiming legal rights you have not checked.

replies.line: The tree will wait while we read the paperwork.
replies.why: Light humor slows the demand without making the neighbor the target.
replies.delivery: Use a neutral tone and avoid claiming legal rights you have not checked.

followUp.jab: It's common sense, not a rule.
followUp.line: I understand your preference; I'm not agreeing to removal without reviewing the facts.
followUp.why: It separates a preference from a decision you have agreed to make.
followUp.delivery: Use a neutral tone and avoid claiming legal rights you have not checked.
